method: One selected ordinary cast under ranked-equivalent standard resources. Initial player/boss placement is setup only. After spawning, the controller uses real directional inputs only; no attacks, E/R/Space, HP edits, teleports, cooldown edits or hazard/projectile deletion. It waits the listed reaction after each individual lock/visible fixed-warning cue before using the public escape target. Source geometry and actual hits are resolved at 30/60Hz.
limitations: These are geometry-aware input policies, not measured human success rates.
The individual cast fixture does not evaluate multi-boss resource attrition; full challenge runs do that separately.
